paragraphs: The F-Pace D180 is a 2.0-litre diesel variant of Jaguar's X761-generation SUV, produced from 2016 to 2025. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine from Jaguar Land Rover's modern modular engine family. The AJ200D was designed as a modern, clean diesel, but like many common-rail diesel engines, it has known wear points at higher mileages—specifically on the timing chain and injector seals. The F-Pace D180 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every F-Pace D180 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the F-Pace D180 from 2016 to 2025 (X761 generation). Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Check Your AJ200D F-Pace D180 → [link to quote form]

compatibility.intro: The F-Pace D180 uses a single engine code, the Ingenium AJ200D, throughout its entire production run. This makes the rebuild process straightforward, as there are no generation-based engine changes for this specific variant. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: - Your exact engine code (AJ200D) via registration or VIN
- Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Jaguar quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
